description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) to allow for two additional roof windows on block A, three additional roof windows on block B and two additional roof windows on block C of planning permission 00133/AW/P4 approved under appeal APP/F5540/W/17/3177013 on 16/11/2017 for the conversion of roof space to existing blocks of flats to provide seven two-bedroom flats and associated car parking, cycle storage and refuse storage.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin no later than 16 November 2020.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (713/400 Rev A - Site Location Plan; 713/401 Rev B - Existing Site Plan; 713/402 Rev C - Proposed Site and Flats Plan; 713/403 Rev C - Proposed Site and Roof Plan; 713/404 Rev A - Existing & Proposed Loft Plan Block A; 713/405 Rev A - Existing & Proposed Loft Plan Block B; 713/406 Rev A - Existing & Proposed Loft Plan Block C; 713/407 Rev A - Existing & Proposed South East Elevation Block A; 713/408 Rev A - Existing & Proposed SW & NE Elevation Block A; 713/409 Rev A - Existing & Proposed North West Elevation Block A; 713/410 Rev A - Existing & Proposed South East Elevation Block B; 713/411 Rev A - Existing & Proposed NE & SW Elevation Block B; 713/412 Rev A - Existing & Proposed North West Elevation Block B; 713/413 Rev A - Existing & Proposed SE Elevation Block C; 713/414 Rev A - Existing & Proposed NE/SW Elevations Block C; 713/415 Rev A - Existing & Proposed NW Elevation Block C; 713/416 Rev A - Proposed Typical Sections 1 Block A; 713/417 Rev A - Proposed Typical Sections 2 Block A; 713/418 Rev A - Proposed Roof Plan Block A; 713/419 Rev A - Existing & Proposed Loft Plan Block B; 713/420 Rev A - Existing & Proposed Loft Plan Block C; 713/422 Rev A - Block A Existing and Proposed View; 713/423 Rev A - Block B Existing and Proposed View; 713/424 Rev A - Block C Existing and Proposed View; 713/SK088 P1 - Proposed Cycle and Refuse Stores Site Plan; 4441/304 - Extent of Adopted Highway.
A101, A102, A103, A104, A105, A106, B01. Received: 18/12/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the material details approved as part of application 00133/AW/P4(3-15) on 21/12/2018.

Condition : 4 - Demolition and construction works shall take place only between 0800 and 1800 on Monday to Friday and 0900 to 1300 on Saturdays, and shall not take place at any time on Sundays or on Bank or Public Holidays without the prior written agreement of the local planning authority.

Condition : 5 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the cycle parking details approved as part of application 00133/AW/P4(3-15) on 21/12/2018. The cycle parking provision shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details prior to the first occupation and retained in the approved form for the lifetime of the development.

Condition : 6 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the waste and recycling details approved as part of application 00133/AW/P4(3-15) on 21/12/2018. The provision of waste and recycling storage facilities shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details prior to the first occupation and retained in the approved form for the lifetime of the development.

Condition : 7 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the hard and soft landscaping details approved as part of application 00133/AW/P4(3-15) on 21/12/2018. The hard and soft landscaping shall be retained for the lifetime of the development.
Condition : 8 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the construction method statement details approved as part of application 00133/AW/P4(3-15) on 21/12/2018.

Condition : 9 - The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied unless the parking, loading and turning areas have been provided in accordance with approved plans 713/402 Rev C - Proposed Site and Flats Plan and 713/403 Rev C - Proposed Site and Roof Plan. The parking, loading and turning areas shall thereafter be retained and kept available for the parking, loading and turning of vehicles associated with the development.

Condition : 10 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the solar photovoltaic system details approved as part of application 00133/AW/P4(10) on 19/11/2019. The solar photovoltaic system shall be retained for the lifetime of the development.

Condition : 11 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the car parking management plan details approved as part of application 00133/AW/P4(11) on 01/11/2019. The car parking areas shall be managed in compliance with the approved Car Park Management Plan.

Condition : 12 - No development, other than demolition and ground works, shall take place until a Stopping-Up Order has been put in place to enable the provision of the parking spaces shown on the approved plans 713/402 Rev C - Proposed Site and Flats Plan and 713/403 Rev C - Proposed Site and Roof Plan.

Condition : 13 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details approved as part of application 00133/AW/P4(13) on 22/11/2019. No resident of the development, with the exception of disabled persons, shall obtain a resident's parking permit within any Controlled Parking Zone which may be in force in the administrative district of the local planning authority at any time

Condition : 14 - The development shall not be occupied until the additional parking spaces (including spaces for people with disabilities and any electric vehicle charging points approved) and the access to them have been provided in accordance with the scheme shown on approved plans 713/402 Rev C - Proposed Site and Flats Plan and 713/403 Rev C - Proposed Site and Roof Plan. This provision shall be permanently available for the occupants of the dwellings hereby approved and used for no other purpose.

Condition : 15 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the step-free entry details approved as part of application 00133/AW/P4(3-15) on 21/12/2018. The step-free entry shall be retained in the approved form for the lifetime of the development.
